Students majoring in orchestral conducting have the opportunity to collaborate with a professional orchestra during their studies. The Stuttgart Chamber Orchestra is available to students several times a year for rehearsal phases as an orchestra.

In order for conducting and vocal performance students to gain practical experience in collaborating with an orchestra, the Southwest German Chamber Orchestra Pforzheim is available twice a year for a joint concert.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The CAMPUS GEGENWART is a "Landeszentrum" for networking in practice and reflection. It is part of the HMDK Stuttgart and collaborates with the State Academy of Fine Arts Stuttgart. The CAMPUS GEGENWART is a place where interdisciplinary artistic methods are explored and transdisciplinary performance can be tested.
